topic: What time does the last Tube leave Brixton on a Saturday night?

text: Morning 👀 does anyone know what time the last tube leaves brixton on a saturday night? Thinking about sat's gig
No idea. Tfl app?
@claude what time does the last tube leave brixton on a saturday night

Brixton doesn't have a fixed last tube on Saturday night, because the Victoria line runs all night as the Night Tube. Trains run roughly every 10 minutes to Walthamstow Central. I couldn't confirm the exact times, and engineering works can change them, so check TfL's status before Saturday: tfl.gov.uk/tube/stop/940GZZLUBXN/brixton-underground-station
question: @claude what time does the last tube leave brixton on a saturday night
